subject.title: Stale .jsonl.lock + stuck typing indicator after EmbeddedAttemptSessionTakeoverError on parallel subagent fan-out

question: Should this issue remain the canonical coordination point for the overlapping takeover, session-lock, and message-loss fixes, or should maintainers split it and pick narrower canonical items for each remaining symptom?
rationale: The retained-lock slice is merged, but current source and live discussion still show overlapping unresolved false-takeover, message-loss, suspended-delivery, and typing cleanup work that could conflict if automated independently.

options.title: Keep as coordination issue
options.body: Leave this issue open as the canonical tracker while maintainers sequence https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89039, https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/86540, https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/91797, and any typing cleanup follow-up.

options.title: Split into narrower canonicals
options.body: Close or retitle this only after creating or linking separate canonical items for false takeovers, suspended delivery and message loss, and Telegram typing cleanup.

options.title: Declare retained-lock-only scope
options.body: Treat this report as solved by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93740 and require new issues for later reports, but that would discard useful linked evidence from current comments.
